single_asset_note: MeanReversionStrategy._build_diagnostics and MomentumStrategy._build_diagnostics return a static all-True gate table, so single-asset enriched gates are not a per-bar diagnostic and are excluded from the breakdown rather than misreported.
interpretation: Lowest pooled pass share is 'rolling_stable_ok' (0.0029) — this is the binding constraint that most often blocks pair entries under strict fail-closed gates. This localizes the cause only; it is not an edge and must not be used to weaken gates.
